description: Comune di Verona - centraline open source per monitoraggio transito biciclette is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Regione Veneto. Il presente dataset, tramite il link indicato, permette di visualizzare in tempo reale e di scaricare lo storico dei passaggi rilevati dalla rete di telecamere open-source dotate di algoritmi di Machine Learning addestrati a rilevare il numero di biciclette che transitano su una strada. Coverage: Regione Veneto. The portal files it under the publisher Regione Veneto. Its tags are biciclette, traffico, trasporti, veicoli. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTML. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
